dogecoin.text: Grayscale filed an S-1 with the SEC to convert its Dogecoin Trust into a spot Dogecoin ETF, to trade under ticker GDOG on NYSE Arca. This move gave DOGE a ~2–2.5% boost. The fund would provide regulated exposure without requiring investors to hold DOGE directly.

Qubic—behind this week’s Monero 51% attack—has voted to target Dogecoin next, beating out Zcash and Kaspa. Dogecoin (market cap $35B +) received over 300 votes, more than all other options combined. Qubic’s mining pool currently controls ~2.32 GH/s on Monero.
